correctness.rationale: Directly verified exact binomial-square formula; for each dyadic shift, Vandermonde plus Lucas implies a uniform termwise valuation floor. A separate coefficient evaluation mod 2^(s+3) gives a universal sharp witness n=1 for s>=2; explicit residues cover s=0,1. The exact least periods follow by excluding the half-period. The attached independent-of-input verifier checks many finite cases but is not the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Sun (arXiv:1009.2486) studies odd-prime Delannoy sums; Noe 2006 gives base-prime divisibility criteria. Lengyel 2021 Theorem 3 gives valuations near pure powers of two but Conjecture 4 explicitly posits, rather than proves, a dyadic difference law for nonzero offsets; the present b=1 case and global exact period law are not consequences of these inspected statements. Djadi--Belbachir 2026 concerns odd-prime triangle congruences. No equivalence identified in multiple actually executed published-finding corpus searches. Literature priority is not guaranteed.
residual_risks: A more general previously published p-adic continuity theorem or an unindexed exact Delannoy period classification could cover the result.
Conjecture 4 might have later proofs not surfaced by this bounded search.
